sections.text: Total revenue was 124 million dollars and operating income was 16 million dollars for the quarter.
Net cash provided by operating activities was 96 million dollars. Purchases of property and equipment were 34 million dollars.

Segment revenue was 124 million dollars compared with 110 million dollars in the prior-year quarter. Reported segment revenue includes acquired operations; organic growth excludes acquisition effects. The acquisition effect was not quantified.
Operating cash flow reflects working-capital movements and cash restructuring payments during the quarter.
Adjusted free cash flow excludes 23 million dollars of cash restructuring payments; the measure is operating cash flow less capital expenditures plus those payments.
